mentions.name: Relevant
mentions.description: A crowdsourcing website where users categorize the YouTube channels they watch into a defined hierarchy of categories, from broad topics like Science and Gaming down to specific ones like Phone Reviews or Speedrunning, so viewers can find YouTube content that fits their interests.
mentions.problem: YouTube latches onto one or two topics a viewer has watched and only recommends that type of content over and over, and the 'Not Interested' tool changes little, making it hard to discover content matching your interests.
mentions.source_excerpt: At the end of last year I launched Relevant - a crowdsourcing website where users can categorize the channels they watch into a defined hierarchy of categories ranging from broad topics like "Science" and "Gaming" to more specific ones like "Phone Reviews" or "Speedrunning".
